Get affine transformation

Source: R/basics.R
get_affine_transform.Rd

Computes an affine transformation for a set of cues in data. Returns an MVBU_TransformInformation object representing a linear map \(f(x) = A(x + b)\), where \(b\) is the shift vector and \(A\) is the scale/rotation matrix.

Usage

get_affine_transform(
  data,
  cues,
  type = c("identity", "center", "standardize", "PCA whiten", "ZCA whiten")[1]
)

Arguments

data

A tibble or data.frame.

cues

A character vector of column names in data that should be transformed.

type

The type of transformation to apply. Can be one of "identity", "center", "standardize", "PCA whiten", or "ZCA whiten". Except for the identity transform, all transforms center. Standardize additionally divides by the standard deviations. PCA whitening rotates the data into the space of principal components with unit variance. ZCA whitening achieves unit variance while maintaining original orientation as close as possible. (default: "identity")

Value

An MVBU_TransformInformation object that can be used to transform data or models.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  vot = rnorm(50, 20, 10),
  f0 = rnorm(50, 220, 25)
)
# Standardize transformation
trans <- get_affine_transform(df, cues = c("vot", "f0"),
                              type = "standardize")
trans
#> <MVBU_TransformInformation>
